scope: R-IMG-1.4 and future V2 image-variant UX
decision: A visually acceptable source-grounded variant may remain usable even when some geometry or surface information is inferred, but the inference must be visible to the author at variant selection/review time.
principles: Do not collapse inferred variants into the same status as original or purely deterministic recompositions.
Inference status belongs to the variant/provenance layer, not to the factual product record itself.
The warning is an authoring/review signal and should not be printed into the catalog by default.
Exported metadata should preserve the inference/review state for traceability.
This record does not freeze a production schema or final UI wording.

provisionalUxDirection.selectionWarning: Esta variante preserva a referência original, mas contém elementos visuais inferidos. Revise antes do uso.
provisionalUxDirection.firstUseBehavior: A lightweight acknowledgment may be appropriate on first use, but remains an open UX decision.

currentH45A0Interpretation: The first valid direct-source-bound A0 result is a candidate for light-inference/review-required because the output presents a more rectified/orthographic view than the factual source and therefore may expose or resolve geometry not fully visible in the source.
researchBoundary: Continue the producer experiment independently; this warning decision must not be used to excuse fantasy hardware, changed topology, invented fittings, or other factual failures.
